categories.main_business_segments: Fortune Brands Innovations operates two main business segments: Water Innovations and Outdoors & Security. Water Innovations focuses on manufacturing and selling faucets, accessories, kitchen sinks, and waste disposals under brands such as Moen, ROHL, Riobel, Victoria+Albert, Perrin & Rowe, Aqualisa, and Shaws. Outdoors & Security produces fiberglass and steel entry door systems, storm and security doors, composite decking and railing, urethane millwork, locks, safety and security devices, and fire-resistant safes under brands like Therma-Tru, Larson, Fiberon, Fypon, Master Lock, American Lock, and SentrySafe.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced manufacturing and assembly processes, including automation, machine learning, and data-driven insights, to produce its products. It emphasizes innovation in water management, connected and smart home technologies, sustainability, and material conversion. Intellectual property, including patents and trademarks, supports product differentiation, and the company invests in digital transformation to enhance product development and customer experience.
categories.primary_customers_markets: FBIN serves a diverse customer base including kitchen and bath dealers, wholesalers, builders, professional remodelers, industrial and locksmith distributors, home centers, e-commerce retailers, and specialty dealers. Major end markets include residential new construction, repair and remodel, and commercial building products, with significant sales to large U.S. home improvement retailers such as Lowe’s and The Home Depot.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in North America (United States, Canada), with additional presence in China, Europe, Mexico, Southeast Asia, South America, Central America, Africa, and Australia. Approximately 20% of net sales are to international markets, with key manufacturing and distribution facilities in the U.S., Mexico, Europe, Africa, Asia, and Canada.
categories.supply_chain_position: Fortune Brands Innovations operates primarily as a downstream manufacturer and assembler, selling finished branded products to distributors, retailers, and end customers. The company sources raw materials and components globally and manages a robust supply chain to deliver finished goods through various sales channels.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic focus is on brand leadership, innovation, and channel excellence, with ongoing investments in digital transformation, supply chain optimization, and sustainability. R&D initiatives target connected products, water conservation, smart home integration, and material innovation. The company also pursues growth through acquisitions, capacity expansion, and entry into adjacent product categories.
categories.revenue_model: FBIN generates revenue primarily through the sale of branded physical products to wholesalers, retailers, and distributors. Revenue is recognized upon transfer of control to customers, with additional income from aftermarket parts, accessories, and, increasingly, digital and connected product offerings. The company also receives revenue from international sales and e-commerce channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Masco, Kohler, LIXIL Group, InSinkErator (Whirlpool), Masonite, JELD-WEN, Andersen, Trex, Azek, Abus, Allegion, Assa Abloy, and various regional and private-label brands. FBIN positions itself as a market leader with strong brands, innovation, and customer service, competing on quality, design, technology, and channel relationships.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, Fortune Brands Innovations reported $4.7 billion in net sales from continuing operations, with a compounded annual net sales growth rate of 11.8% over the past three years. Operating income was $774 million in 2022, with operating margins between 15% and 17%. The company has over 11,200 employees and maintains a strong balance sheet, supporting ongoing investments and shareholder returns.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: FBIN’s value proposition centers on market-leading brands, innovative and high-quality products, and a diversified channel mix. The company differentiates through design, technology (including smart and connected products), sustainability, and customer service, aiming to deliver superior performance, reliability, and style to both consumers and trade customers.
